description.value: Red Swan Pizza is a Canadian-owned pizza franchise founded in Saskatchewan in 1993 and now operating 160+ locations across six provinces. The Langley location offers fresh, made-from-scratch gourmet pizza available for pickup or delivery, with a full menu of pizzas, pastas, salads, wings, and desserts. Catering services are also available, making it a practical stop for groups or events along a cycling route.
